summary: Main Street Capital Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a credit facility amendment, not a special situation. The amendment increased revolving commitments to $1.24 billion and accordion capacity to $1.86 billion, extended the revolving period to June 2030 and maturity to June 2031. No ownership change, tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine refinancing/credit agreement amendment that does not qualify as a special-situation event under the defined categories.
